_comment: Booked one-off events. The recurring club nights are generated in the page itself, not listed here; an entry here of a regular night's own type (league, social, study, adobe) replaces that night on that date. Types and their colours: battle = club against club (violet) | outing = the club somewhere else, not chess at the club (gold) | theme = a club night with a theme, like costume night (pink) | tournament, lecture, simul, special (scarlet) | league | social | study | adobe.

events.title: Battle for the Bay: Tampa vs Bradenton
events.title_es: Battle for the Bay: Tampa vs Bradenton
events.addr: Tampa Knights Chess Club, 1919 N Howard Ave, Tampa, FL 33607
events.note: Tampa Knights against Kava Social, away in Tampa. One open section, Swiss format. $15 if you register on Chess67, $20 at the door. Prizes for the winners.
events.note_es: Tampa Knights contra Kava Social, de visita en Tampa. Una sección abierta, sistema suizo. $15 si te inscribes en Chess67, $20 en la puerta. Con premios para los ganadores.

events.title: Movie Night: Grandmasters on the Big Screen
events.title_es: Noche de cine: Grandmasters en pantalla grande
events.addr: AMC Bradenton 20, 2507 53rd Ave E, Bradenton, FL
events.note: The club goes to the movies. Grandmasters follows Magnus Carlsen and the breakaway league out to shake up top-level chess. Two nights only, so buy your own ticket and sit with us. League bracket after at Kava Social, 9:15 PM. Warm-up boards from 8.
events.note_es: El club va al cine. Grandmasters sigue a Magnus Carlsen y a la liga que quiere sacudir el ajedrez de élite. Solo dos noches: compra tu entrada y siéntate con nosotros. Después, bracket de liga en Kava Social a las 9:15 PM. Tableros de calentamiento desde las 8.

events.title: League night, late start
events.note: Bracket starts at 9:15 PM, after movie night. Want to warm up first? Boards are open from 8.
events.note_es: El bracket empieza a las 9:15 PM, después de la noche de cine. ¿Quieres calentar antes? Tableros abiertos desde las 8.

events.title: Costume Chess Night: Halloween Bracket
events.title_es: Noche de ajedrez con disfraces: bracket de Halloween
events.note: Holiday special: this Sunday is usually free play, but for Halloween we are running a bracket. Come in costume, every level welcome. Costume contest with a prize for the best costume, plus prizes for the bracket winners.
events.note_es: Especial de fiestas: este domingo suele ser de juego libre, pero por Halloween vamos a jugar un bracket. Ven disfrazado, todos los niveles son bienvenidos. Concurso de disfraces con premio al mejor disfraz, y premios para los ganadores del bracket.

events.title: Battle for the Bay 2: Bradenton vs Tampa
events.title_es: Battle for the Bay 2: Bradenton vs Tampa
events.note: Round two, on our patio: Tampa Knights against Kava Social. A Swiss-style team battle in four sections, every win a point for your team. Section prizes of $100, $60, $40 and $30, a trophy for every section winner and a Best Female Player trophy. All levels welcome, 21+.
events.note_es: Segunda ronda, en nuestro patio: Tampa Knights contra Kava Social. Una batalla por equipos tipo suizo en cuatro secciones, cada victoria un punto para tu equipo. Premios por sección de $100, $60, $40 y $30, un trofeo para cada ganador de sección y un trofeo a la Mejor Jugadora. Todos los niveles son bienvenidos, 21+.
